name: Toyosu, Tsukiji, then Ginza on foot
tag: Auction at 5:30, lunch at 12:00, done about 15:30
why: The early part is all near the market and you do it at your own pace. After lunch everything is in Ginza, flat and on foot, and it ends a short walk from your hotel.
bars: Ginza on foot to the hotel
steps: Tuna auction deck, Toyosu
Check-in at the PR corner, Block 7, 3F. Reception number 53241. Ends about 6:25.
Breakfast at the market
Sushi or a seafood bowl in the market restaurant area.
teamLab Planets
Premium Pass x2. Show the QR at the Information Center, no queue. About 1.5 hours.
Tsukiji Outer Market
Taxi, about 15 minutes. Tamagoyaki, grilled scallops, kitchen knives.
Lunch at Ginza Sushimasa, with Yuuki
Counter for three. Short lunch courses: 5 small dishes and 7 pieces of nigiri (¥9,900), or 7 pieces with a small chirashi bowl (¥4,950). We choose at the table.
Itoya
Twelve floors of paper, pens and letter sets. Gifts that pack flat.
Mitsukoshi food hall
Wagashi, tea, rice crackers and boxed sweets from all over Japan.
Kimuraya
The bakery that made the first sweet bean bun, in 1874. On the Ginza crossing.
GINZA SIX roof garden and tea
A free garden on the roof, then matcha at Nakamura Tokichi on the 4th floor.
Back at the hotel
About 10 minutes on foot to THE BLOSSOM HIBIYA.
moves: Market → teamLab: 1 stop on the Yurikamome or a 5 min taxi. teamLab → Tsukiji: taxi about 15 min. Tsukiji → Sushimasa: 10 min on foot. Everything after lunch is on foot.
good: A full day that never needs a long train ride.
mind: The Ginza walk after lunch is a suggestion. If you would rather rest, we stop whenever you like. Lunch is ordered at the table; the booking is for seats only.
